## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `569c58e52e4784ff6a0b5229ede2af1f51978198`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0095-authz-kernel-tenant-layer-and-posture-ladder.md, docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md + scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json, scripts/check-platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-preference.object.ts, the 21 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts` files the note names, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts, packages/core/src/security/tenant-layer0-verdict.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts, packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts, packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (on `origin/main` after #24398)

Rules face, the two governed `docs/adr/**` paths. Read-only: every tree reading is `git show` / `git grep` on `refs/review/pr-24408` (fetched to a ref of my own; head `569c58e52e…`, merge base with `origin/main` `78652c093c…`) and on `origin/main` (fetched at 2026-10-18T23:32:35Z: `31e7d0ba27…`); every GitHub reading is a `gh api` GET. Nothing built, tested, re-run or ablated; the only tool runs were the brief's own `record-recognisers --template` and `post-stamped --dry-run`. Inputs: card #24339 (body, claim `6256231065`, dev reports `6256329876` and `6256506911`, seat answer `6256351977`, weighed as a seat record, not as a verdict), ruling E′ `6250748677` on #24164 and the three sibling cards #24338 / #24340 / #24341, PR #24408 (body, file list, net diff `78652c093c…`..`569c58e52e…`: +29 / −0 in the two ADR files, two commits), and the check-runs on the head. Record written 2026-10-18T23:39Z.

### ① Derived judgments

Every sentence of the two hunks, named right or wrong against the ruling and the tree at the head.

1. **"Layer 0 is inert on 22 of the 23 objects the ruling names, which carry no `organization_id` column" — right.** The census at the head (`scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`, `totals` 83 / 44 in / 39 out, `unexplained: []`) reads all 22 as `reach: out`, `tenantField: null`: 21 by `managedBy: 'better-auth'` (`sys_api_key` also `tenancy.enabled: false`), `sys_audit_log` by `systemFields.tenant: false`. None of the 21 identity object files declares an `organization_id` field (0 declarations each, read file by file); `sys_audit_log` carries `tenant_id`, a plain attribution lookup its own header says the tenant-field resolver does not claim (ADR-0131 D7). The injection plan gives a better-auth table nothing (`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts:206`) and no tenant column under either opt-out (:155). plugin-security feeds the wall `objectHasOrgIdField = objectFields.has('organization_id') && !meta.tenantAnchorIsPhantom` (`security-plugin.ts:7469`) and `tenancyDisabled` from the object's two opt-outs (:9142, :9587); `computeTenantLayer0Verdict` answers `none` on either (`tenant-layer0-verdict.ts:137-138`), under every posture. The note's reason is the code's second exit; on `sys_audit_log` and `sys_api_key` the first exit fires too, and the reason the note gives is still true of them.
2. **"The 23rd, `sys_user_preference`, carries the organisation column, so Layer 0 bounds it to its organisation" — right.** `managedBy: 'system-data'` (`sys-user-preference.object.ts:30`), no opt-out, so the plan injects `organization_id`; the census reads `reach: in`, `tenantField: organization_id`, `reasons: []`; its unique index is `unique: 'organization'` on `[user_id, key]` (:129, ADR-0120 D1). With the column present and no opt-out the verdict is `organization` under `isolated` and `organizations` under `group`. One implicit qualifier: under `single` Layer 0 is inert on every object (D1's own rule, two paragraphs above the note; `tenant-layer0-verdict.ts:131`). The note sits under D1, which carries that qualifier, and the PR body spells it out; an observation, not a misstatement.
3. **"its declared default is to apply inside that wall" — right, and decided-not-built.** D1 AND-composes Layer 0 before and independently of Layer 1; the declared default is a Layer 1 policy applied at the collection point (ruling item 2), so it composes inside the wall. The literal it will carry is `sys_user_preference_self`, shipped in three sets today (`default-permission-sets.ts:546`, `:974`, `:1301`).
4. **"On all 23, Layer 1 silence (no held set carries a row policy for the object) is to mean the object's declared default row scope, not no filter" — right.** Ruling item 2 and item 8's second clause; "is to".
5. **"The default is a protocol key on the object (`ObjectSchema.defaultRowScope`, #24338)" — present tense; false on this head's base, true on `origin/main` now and at merge time.** At the merge base `78652c093c…`, `git grep defaultRowScope` on `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` exits 1 (control `nameField`: 16 hits). PR #24398 (#24338) merged at 2026-10-18T23:30:16Z as `31e7d0ba27…`, and on that `origin/main` `object.zod.ts:2993` reads `defaultRowScope: DefaultRowScopeSchema.optional().describe(`; the key name the note writes is the one that landed. The PR body's landing order ("this PR lands after #24398") is therefore satisfied by the tree, and the queue rebuilds this PR onto current `main`, so the sentence is true at merge time. Right.
6. **"the platform objects are to declare it themselves (#24341)" — right**, ruling item 3; "are to". #24341 is open, `pm:blocked` on #24338 and #24339.
7. **"the one collection point is to apply it (#24340)" — right**, ruling item 2; "is to". #24340 is open, `pm:blocked` on the same two.
8. **"the registry is to refuse an `extend` contributor that sets or loosens it (#24341)" — right**, ruling item 4 ("cannot set or loosen … refused at registration with a named reason"); "is to".
9. **The precedent line — right**: the card's `## What changes` sentence, verbatim.
10. **The 23 names — right, each spelled as the census and the object files spell it, no glob.** The seven SCIM names equal the seven `object:` values inside `scimProjectionRowScope()` (`default-permission-sets.ts:171-191`); `sys_verification` / `sys_jwks` equal `privateCredentialRowScope()` (:243-245); `sys_audit_log` equals `auditLedgerRowScope()`'s `sys_audit_log_org` (:291); the 13 identity names equal ruling item 3's list and #24341's. 7 + 2 + 13 + 1 = 23; the note names 22 plus `sys_user_preference`. The card's `sys_oauth_*` glob expands to 7 objects in the tree, three of which (`sys_oauth_resource`, `sys_oauth_client_resource`, `sys_oauth_client_assertion`) carry no shipped row policy; the card's "better-auth-managed" label does not fit `sys_user_preference` (`system-data`) or `sys_audit_log` (`append-only`); the tree's eighth `sys_scim_` object, `sys_scim_connection_credential`, reads `reach: in` and is no declarer. The note follows the ruling in all three places.
11. **The ADR-0095 status-line entry — right and in form.** It restates the note, keeps "are to declare" / "is to mean", and names the key as "a protocol key (#24338)". Shape `· **Amended** (date, ruling of record N on #card, letter X) — … See the note under D1.` on the line after `**Status**:` and before `**Deciders**:`, as ADR-0090's six entries are.
12. **The ADR-0090 sentence — right.** The D12 2026-10-17 note's last paragraph holds "the general case … for the maintainer's decision on #24164"; the appended sentence says that case is ruled (E′, `6250748677`), restates items 1–2 in "is to" form, points to ADR-0095's note under D1, and states item 9 in substance: #24136 keeps the three conditions (a) (b) (c), present at the head, and gains no fourth. No status-line entry on ADR-0090 is right: nothing ADR-0090 decided moves, and the card asked for one cross-reference line.
13. **The quoted maintainer word — exact.** Ruling `6250748677` line 1 reads `Ruling: batch #365 item 4 · letter E′ · maintainer 「同意」` followed by its own stamp (the comment's creation instant, 2026-10-18T13:55:32Z), and its body "The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「同意」"; the note's heading quotes the same two characters in the same `— the maintainer's 「同意」)` form the 2026-10-17 note under ADR-0090 D12 uses.
14. **Fidelity to item 8 and the card's `## What changes`.** The note carries all four of item 8's terms: a dated note under D1, Layer 1 silence means the declared default rather than no filter, the default is a protocol key, and it lands before the code (#24340 and #24341 are blocked on it). It carries nothing the ruling did not decide: items 2, 3, 4 and 9 are cited where they appear; the scope limit, pins and declarations (items 5–7) are the code cards' and are rightly absent. The one departure from item 8's letter — 22 inert, one walled — is attributed to the census, never to the ruling.
15. **Amendment form against the repo's rules.** Prime Directive #13: the decision is extended on the old ADR with an amended status line, not reversed by a new one, and the ADR lives in the repo whose code it governs. No `scripts/adr-anchors/*.json` pins a line inside either ADR (seven anchor files cite ADR-0095 or ADR-0090 by symbol, none by ADR line), so the +24 / +5 line shift moves nothing. Dated blockquote at the end of D1, just before `### D2`; the card number `#24339;` added to the heading is a harmless addition the 2026-10-17 precedent lacks.

### ② Semver level

Docs only: two `docs/adr/**` files, nothing a released package publishes. `skip-changeset` is the right disposition (Post-Task Checklist 3: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package), and `Clause-②: no` is right for a note; the contract key's own `Clause-②: yes (widening)` rode on #24398. Check-runs, read twice: at 2026-10-18T23:32:34Z 40 runs, `Check Changeset` run `117820388210` `failure` (completed 2026-10-18T23:29:37Z, before the label), `skip-changeset` labeled by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` at 2026-10-18T23:30:43Z, re-run `117821105107` `skipped` at 2026-10-18T23:30:46Z, four lanes still `in_progress`; at 2026-10-18T23:34:46Z 43 runs, all completed: 31 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 1 `failure` — the superseded first `Check Changeset` run. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, every `Lint ·` lane, every `Type Check ·` lane, `Test Core` 1–6, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check PR Size` and the three card-claim guards are `success`; `Build Core` and the full-battery jobs are `skipped` on the docs-only path filter. PR at read: draft, `mergeable_state: clean`, labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`, assignee the card's.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The dev's `needs_decision` 1 and the seat's answer A (`6256351977`): the item 8 correction.** Answered, and the seat is right that it is a documentation-accuracy correction with the decision unchanged. Items 1–7, 9 and 10 are untouched; item 3's declarers stay 23 with `sys_user_preference` among them, so #24341's list and test do not move; item 2's semantics do not depend on inertness; item 8's four binding terms are all met. "Inert on these objects" was a premise in the seat-written ruling text that the census contradicts on one object, and the alternatives were worse: B drops a live declarer and reopens the gap E′ closes inside one organisation, C publishes a sentence the CI-held census refutes (Prime Directive #10). No director re-record is needed before landing: the surface is Tier H, so the maintainer reads this exact note before it merges, and the PR body's `## A correction to the ruling's sentence` puts the departure in front of that read. One follow-up for the seat, outside this record: a one-line pointer on #24164 from the ruling thread to the ADR note, so the ruling record and the ADR do not diverge silently.
- **The dev's question 2 (the card's glob and label).** Answered A; right, per judgment 10. The card body stays as filed; the note and the thread are the record.
- **Landing order.** The PR body says this PR lands after #24398. It now can: #24398 merged at 2026-10-18T23:30:16Z, and `defaultRowScope` is on `origin/main`. The PR body and its Chinese brief still say #24398 "is in the merge queue" — true when written at 2026-10-18T23:27:12Z, stale now; the seat may refresh the brief, and nothing in the diff depends on it.
- **Tier H.** Both paths are `docs/adr/**`; the PR is draft and carries no reviewer, no approval, no auto-merge. This record is the contract-tier review the dispatch asked for before the maintainer reads; it does not lift the Tier H landing — that is an authorized approval and then the owning seat, or the maintainer's hand (Prime Directive #14).
- **The PR body's `## 维护者速读(草稿)` against the diff.** It says the same as the diff: docs only; a dated note under ADR-0095 D1 plus a status-line entry; one cross-reference sentence at the end of ADR-0090 D12's 2026-10-17 note; the E′ meaning (the object declares its default; silence means that default, not no filter); the 22-of-23 correction with `sys_user_preference` walled and its default applying inside the wall; the 23 declarers, key, collection point and registry rule unchanged; the maintainer can veto on this PR; rollback is the two text hunks. `席位意见` is empty, left for the seat to fill before the maintainer reads; not a diff matter.
- **Size.** +29 against the card's "about 15": the 22 spelled-out names (the seat's no-glob answer) and the `sys_user_preference` sentence. Accepted.
- **Observation, no re-spin asked:** judgment 2's posture qualifier. A later touch to the note could add "under a posture that enforces the wall" after "bounds it to its organisation"; D1 already says it.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24339-adr-0095-default-row-scope-note`
Reviewed-by: `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 · PR #24408 · `domain:spec` seat 2 · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK` · 2026-10-18T23:40Z

**改了什么**
只改两份 ADR 文本,共 +29 行,不碰代码,也不发版。
- ADR-0095 D1 下加一条 2026-10-18 的修订说明,头部状态行加一条 `Amended` 记录。说明的内容:
  - 平台的 22 个身份对象没有组织列,Layer 0(租户隔离)对它们不起作用。逐个点名,包括 SCIM 七张投影表、`sys_user`、`sys_session`、OAuth 四张表、`sys_audit_log` 等。
  - 第 23 个 `sys_user_preference` 有组织列,所以先被 Layer 0 限在本组织内,它的默认行范围在组织内生效。
  - 这 23 个对象上,没有任何权限集给出行策略时,将按对象自己声明的默认行范围过滤,而不是不过滤。
  - 这个默认行范围是对象上的协议键 `ObjectSchema.defaultRowScope`,已随 #24398 落地。
  - 由谁声明(#24341)、在哪里应用(#24340)、注册时如何拒绝放宽(#24341),都写成「将要」,因为这些代码还没建。
- ADR-0090 D12 在 10-17 修订后补一句:#24164 已裁为 E′,#24136 仍是原来三个条件,不加第四个。

**为什么改**
- 这是你 10-18 「同意」的裁决 E′ 第 8 条。ADR 说明要先于代码落地:#24340(读取端)和 #24341(各对象的声明)都在等它。
- ⚠️ 与裁决原文有一处不同。第 8 条原话是「Layer 0 对这些对象不起作用」,但 dev 实测(本席与契约复核各复核一次)发现 `sys_user_preference` 带组织列。CI 守着的普查文件 `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` 也这样记。
- 所以说明写成「22 个不起作用,1 个被隔在组织内」。
- 决定本身不变:23 个对象照样声明默认值,#24341 的清单和测试都不动。席位的答复在 #24339 `6256351977`。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 纯文本,不改任何运行时行为,风险很低。
- 唯一的代价是 ADR 和裁决原句字面上不一致。我的处理:说明里写明出处是普查文件,并在 #24164 的裁决线程留一条指针,两份记录互相能查到。
- 回滚 = 撤回这两段文本。

**席位意见**
同意合并。契约复核 `6256600360` 判 PASS,没有 FAIL 项。几处已逐条核对:
- 22/1 的实测;
- 23 个对象名逐个拼对,没有用通配;
- 每句「将要」都和代码现状一致;
- 修订格式沿用 ADR-0090 的先例;
- 引用的「同意」与裁决原文一致。

只有一个小观察,不必改:单租户(`single`)姿态下 Layer 0 对所有对象都不起作用。D1 正文两段之上已经写明,这里不重复。

**你要做的(一个动作)**
用 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 在本 PR 上提交 **Approve**,之后席位翻 ready 并经合并队列落地。亲手合并也可以。不同意上面那处修正,就在本 PR 留言,席位会转回决策箱。
